recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further work is only needed if the work group later reopens the Observation multiple-specimen model or wants a separate review of the oyster example; FHIR-39269 itself is already applied correctly.
issue_request: FHIR-39269 asked to remove Specimen from Group member types after Group was tightened toward participant-like members by FHIR-24848, or else justify retaining Specimen. The Published resolution was Not Persuasive with Modification: update Group scope and usage to say Specimen is not typically a participant but remains allowed as a Group member to avoid a breaking change to normative Observation.
initial_application: FHIR-24848 was applied in 272e3fb71e, aligning Group with the participant pattern while retaining Specimen in the Group type/member set. FHIR-39269 was explicitly applied in 6705cadb21, which added the Group Scope and Usage note explaining that Specimen is retained to avoid breaking Observation.
additional_context: FHIR-35972 added Specimen to Group.member.entity for the multiple-specimen Observation use case, and FHIR-34002 allowed Observation.specimen to reference Group with a constraint that such Groups contain specimens. OO minutes on 2023-01-23 explain the multiple-specimen, pooled-sample, OBX-33, and normative cardinality rationale; FHIR-I minutes on 2023-02-20 corroborate the 13-0-0 Not Persuasive with Modification vote. A Zulip search found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current combined branch has Group active in source/fhir.ini, source/group/group-introduction.xml includes the Specimen-retention note, source/group/codesystem-group-type.xml includes the specimen code, and source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml includes Specimen in Group.type guidance and Group.member.entity target profiles.

related_jiras.note: Narrowed Group toward participant-like members and created the context for the Specimen-retention question.
Allowed Observation.specimen to reference Group for multiple specimens without changing normative Observation.specimen cardinality.
Added Specimen to Group.member.entity for the same Observation multiple-specimen use case.
